# iker

Iker is a data scribe.  
In ancient civilizations (such as Egypt), a scribe used to be a
professional copyist who hand-wrote manuscripts and official documents.

The purpose of the package is to externalize data reading and writing so
that applications do not have to manage the I/O layer.

It offers general connectors (file, API) as well as specific
implementations (Supabase, GitHub).

## Installation

Install the package as follows:

### From R-universe

``` r

install.packages('iker', repos = c('https://thekangaroofactory.r-universe.dev', 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))
```

### From GitHub

``` r

pak::pkg_install("thekangaroofactory/iker")
```

# Package index

## Generic connectors

- [`load_data()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/load_data.md)
  : Load Data From Connector
- [`save_data()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/save_data.md)
  : Save Data To Connector
- [`read_data()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/read_data.md)
  : Read Data
- [`write_data()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/write_data.md)
  : Write Data
- [`call_api()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/call_api.md)
  : Call API

## Specific connectors

- [`github()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/github.md)
  : GitHub API
- [`supabase_select()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/supabase_select.md)
  [`supabase_upsert()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/supabase_select.md)
  [`supabase_delete()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/supabase_select.md)
  : Supabase API

## Helpers

- [`from_POSIXct()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/from_POSIXct.md)
  : Convert POSIXct Columns to ISO-8601 Character
- [`to_POSIXct()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/to_POSIXct.md)
  : Convert ISO-8601 Character Columns to POSIXct
- [`rstring()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/rstring.md)
  : Random String
- [`with_cache()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/iker/reference/with_cache.md)
  : With Cache
